metadata.title: Windows Server 2025 Active Directory Group Policy Objects (GPOs) must be configured with proper audit settings.

criterion.comment: Windows Server Active Directory Domain object must be configured with proper audit settings.

independent-def:shellcommand_test.comment: Windows Server Active Directory Domain object must be configured with proper audit settings.

independent-def:shellcommand_object.comment: Query both Fail and Success auditing settings for Domain Organizational Unit (OU) but only return data back on missing or misconfigured OU's
independent-def:shellcommand_object.independent-def:command: $gGuid='f30e3bc2-9ff0-11d1-b603-0000f80367c1'; $zGuid='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'; $gpos=Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'groupPolicyContainer'" -SearchBase ("CN=Policies,CN=System,"+(Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName) -Properties displayName; $results=foreach($gpo in $gpos){$path="AD:\$($gpo.DistinguishedName)"; $aud=(Get-Acl $path -Audit).Audit; $reasons=@(); $fRules=$aud|Where-Object{$_.IdentityReference -match 'Everyone|S-1-1-0' -and $_.AuditFlags -match 'Failure' -and ($_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match 'GenericAll|FullControl|All')}; $vFail=$fRules|Where-Object{$_.InheritanceType -ne 'None' -and ($_.InheritedObjectType.ToString() -eq $zGuid -or $_.InheritedObjectType.ToString() -eq $gGuid)}; if(-not $fRules){$reasons+='MISSING: Everyone to Failure to GenericAll/FullControl audit policy'}elseif(-not $vFail){if($fRules|Where-Object{$_.InheritanceType -eq 'None'}){$reasons+='INVALID SCOPE: Everyone to Failure policy is set to This Object Only (Requires Inheritance)'}else{$reasons+='INVALID SCOPE: Everyone to Failure policy inherits to an incorrect object type (Must be All or groupPolicyContainer)'}}; $sRules=$aud|Where-Object{$_.IdentityReference -match 'Everyone|S-1-1-0' -and $_.AuditFlags -match 'Success' -and ($_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match 'ExtendedRight|WriteProperty')}; $vSucc=$sRules|Where-Object{$_.InheritanceType -ne 'None' -and ($_.InheritedObjectType.ToString() -eq $zGuid -or $_.InheritedObjectType.ToString() -eq $gGuid)}; if(-not $sRules){$reasons+='MISSING: Everyone to Success to ExtendedRight/WriteProperty audit policy'}elseif(-not $vSucc){if($sRules|Where-Object{$_.InheritanceType -eq 'None'}){$reasons+='INVALID SCOPE: Everyone to Success policy is set to This Object Only (Requires Inheritance)'}else{$reasons+='INVALID SCOPE: Everyone to Success policy inherits to an incorrect object type (Must be All or groupPolicyContainer)'}}; if($reasons.Count -gt 0){"Target_Object=$($gpo.displayName) | IdentityReference=Everyone (S-1-1-0) | Status=FAIL | Details=$($reasons -join ' - ')"}}; if($results){$results}else{"Target_Object=All GPOs | IdentityReference=Everyone (S-1-1-0) | Status=PASS | Details=All Active Directory GPO audit ACLs are STIG compliant with correct inheritance scopes."}

independent-def:shellcommand_state.comment: No lines shall exist listed with status of 'FAIL'
